[quote=luonaco;59760757][i][u][b]-Republic of Lonaco- [/b][/u] 
 
President Élise Marchand has invited the United Lavian Republic to discuss joining the EEHP alliance. The Republic of Lonaco is open and welcomes the United Lavian Republic to visit Valsune City. The Royal Principality of the Lavico Family has established agreements in open free trade as well as partnerships in the tourism sector. The Republic of Lonaco would establish foreign embassies between the ULR and Lonaco in the meantime. Lonaco will open foreign investment and trade to ULR. 

[u][b]Lonaco-ULR Trade Deal[/b][/u]

Lonaco will export 35% of its annual olive oil production to ULR, meeting the rising demand for premium and organic products. As well as offering luxury food products, from truffles, cheeses, and fine wines that meet organic and quality standards for the consumer's good. 

In return for trade from ULR, we would like to receive high-quality grains and livestock to support Lonacos food industries. Raw materials, including coal, metals, and minerals, for Lonacos manufacturing and energy sectors would be accepted by trade or sold. 

Lonaco would exchange 30% of advanced healthcare, gene therapy solutions, and pharmaceutical supplies for ULR. As well as cheap solar panels, wind energy technologies, and hydrogen-based power solutions to support ULR energy demands. 

In return for trade from ULR, Machinery and industrial equipment that will support Lonacos growing biotech and automotive sectors. As well as Wind and Hydropower technologies to further expand Lonacos renewable energy. 

Lonaco will export 25% of high-end sports cars and electric vehicles to manufacturers. As well as exporting reasonable cost for Jewelry, Watches, and Fashion with renowned designers to high-quality standards. 

In return for the exchange deal from ULR, Lonaco will promote ULR as a destination for elite tourists, offering access to ULRs luxury resorts, beaches, and cultural events. Forming Joint Cultural Exchange Programs for holding events for art festivals, music festivals, and academic exchanges. 

Lonaco Private Banking and Wealth Management will offer 20% tailored investment strategies, estate management, and wealth planning for ULRs high-net-worth individuals. As well as provide blockchain technologies and digital banking services to ULRs financial institutions.

In return to provide funding for Lonacos tech startups, infrastructure projects, and green technology. Promoting and encouraging cross-border investments and joint financial ventures between ULR and Lonaco.

This trade agreement shall remain in period of 10 years, after which both nations shall review the terms and adjust them if necessary to changes in the deal.

[quote=alkiragunya;59763934][Spoiler=The art of medicine and curing, Arc of Lost totem, chapter 6][i]ONDE ESTÁ O FRAGMENTO DA CORCOVA?![/i]
Kambilla procurou os dois fragmentos que ela tinha guardado, o desespero tomou conta logo ao perceber que só tinha um dos dois.
[i]Está aqui.[/i]
Ngarrajin disse em tom direto, retirando brevemente e a mostrando o fragmento antes de guardar ele de volta em suas vestes.
[I]Ah...mas, como...[/i]
[i]Cópia, nenhum é verdadeiro.[/i]
Ngarrajin tirou a outra parte do fragmento de seu traje.
[i]Ah, mas, ugh, tanto faz...[/i]
Kambilla se sentia confuso sobre como foi enganado tão facilmente pelo mercador, mas ao mesmo tempo, se sentia grata, já que se o atacante tivesse roubado os pedaços dela, seriam só entalhes de madeira comuns...
Eles chegaram rápido à Towurunga, provável pela sorte e mistura de outros fatores, ao deixarem os camelos em um cercado, foram logo ao gunya de cura, Balunji carregou Gillut ainda desacordado, Kambilla não quis ir até os ngankaris, ele optou por simplesmente descansar em seu lar ao lado de seu neto. Dulbara e Gillut foram colocados sobre uma rede, Tjilpi, "o corvo", mesmo que meio excêntrico, chegou até Gillut, e analisou seus ferimentos, era um corte no peito, ao analisar e passar a mão ao redor da área, anunciou ao grupo.
[i]O ferimento não é fatal, seu amigo tem sorte, mas essa marca sombria ficará marcada nele, devo dizer, é algo que nunca vi, mas que, ouvi, esse tipo de ferimento é um ataque ao espírito, "energia sombria", é o nome, e não deveriam mais haver clãs vivos com tal habilidade, ela corrompe espírito e alma, e fisicamente, destrói o corpo como um parasita se não  tratada.[/i]
O grupo(Tjarrampa, Ngarrajin e Balunji) olharam, prestando atenção em cada palavra de Tjilpi, ele logo disse, se virando ao paciente:
[i]Tragam me o extrato de folhas de acácia.[/i]
Tjilpi deu como ordem aos outros curandeiros, um deles o alcançou, seus assistentes passaram o extrato nos ferimentos, Tjilpi o limpou, Gillut dava leves gemidos pela sensação fria e meio dolorosa.
[i]...Wadang....ouça me.[/i]
Tjilpi começou a proferir, enquanto estendia sua mão sob o corte, ele disse.
[i]Warawang[/i].
De seu braço, uma figura de corvo surgiu e foi até entrar no ferimento de Gillut, estava arrancando a energia sombria, e carne podre do ferimento.
[i]Ei Balunji, não é só Wonambi que interage no nosso mundo físico pelo visto.[/i]
Tjarrampa riu de leve dando uma leve batidinha no cotovelo de Balunji, ele só revirou os olhos e Ngarrajin deu uma risada baixa, quase imperceptível.
Do outro lado, Dulbara recebia um chá herbáceo de  um ngankaris, cujo nome era Yumdahri, uma mulher de pele lisa negra e com colares de corvos, que estava designada para ele, o ferimento não era profundo nem nada do tipo.
[i]Pq me dá isso?EU SOU DESCENDENTE DE WARRIGAL, não preciso...[/i]
[i]]Até Warrigal precisou de descanso após a batalha dos 20 clãs.[/i]
Yumdahri respondeu rápido, ela pegou algumas folhas de Yidi(folha conhecida pelas propriedades analgésicas) para servir de compressas em seu peito, que foi atingido em cheio pelo golpe de Balunji.
[i]Hmph, pelo menos eu posso dormir um pouco.[/i]
Yumdahri suspirou de alívio ao ver que ele descansou os olhos.
Por fim, Tjipi finalizou sua técnica, Gillut estava livre da energia sombria, o "corvo" ficou meio pálido, e saiu do gunya, dando a  desculpa: [i]Tenho...que respirar ar fresco.[/i]
Ngarrajin decidiu se aproximar do lado de Gillut, ele criou uma agulha de espinhos, e então pegou uma linha de costura próxima, Yumdahri decidiu intervir, mas foi impedida por Tjarrampa, que a contou:
[i]Rajin sabe sobre medicina...bem, pelo menos em animais, então ele pode ser meio bruto.[/i]
[b]AAAAAGH[/b].
Gillut soltou um grito ao sentir as fincadas de agulha costurando seus ferimentos, Ngarrajin apenas suspirou e murmurou:
[i]Animais são mais fáceis....[/i]
Yumdahri decidiu ajudar, ela pegou folhas de ervas medicinais e as colocou no peito de Gillut, isso o acalmou, e o fez ficar em "anestesia".
Ao terminar de costurar  o ferimento, Rajin tornou a ponta de seu dedo indicador em chamas, chamas fracas, cauterizantes, ao terminar, ele disse:
[i]Está pronto.[/i]
E saiu sem dizer mais nada, Tjarrampa apenas riu levemente e disse.
[i]Sempre dramático Rajin...[/i]
[i]Ele era poderoso, usava energia sombria, isso não deveria estar extinto há muito tempo?[/i]
Foi oque Balunji questionou, ele estava em frente a Mardu e Nghayl, o primeiro tinha seu leque de penas negras cobrindo seu rosto parcialmente, e o último mantinha-se calmo e relaxado, Ngayhl começou falando:
[i]Warrigal carbonizou o totem e sua linhagem, mas não os destruíram, o totem deles foi enegrecido e uma parte, o cabo, destruídos.[/i]
Mardu seguiu a fala:
[i]E esse homem que os atacou, não sabemos quem foi, ele é dos Purinina, seus descendentes ainda vivem, mas poucos são os que lembram de sua ancestralidade, Warrigal não buscava destruir o inimigo, mas sim eliminar sua esperança e sonhos, ele os quebrou quando carbonizou seus totens com suas próprias chamas.[/i]
Nghayhl finalizou:
[i]Talvez essa figura que os atacou, encontrou os outros fragmentos do clã Murkitilpa, e o uniu ao dele para reviver seu clã, isso explica o motivo da tempestade de areia antes do ataque.[/i]
[i]Eu entendo...[/i]
Balunji entendeu, mas ainda estava insatisfeito, não era nada que ele não sabia, ao sair do gunya dos guardiões, se deparou com Kambilla, que o perguntou sobre oque eles disseram, Balunji relutou mas disse:
[i]Nada que não saibamos, ele está usando seu totem para reacender a energia do próprio clã, e que descende de um clã supostamente extinto...[/i]
[i]Hmph[/i]...
Kambilla bufou, igualmente infeliz pela resposta dos outros dois guardiões.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[i]WHERE IS THE HUMP FRAGMENT?![/i]
Kambilla looked for the two fragments she had kept, despair taking over as soon as she realized she only had one of the two.
[i]It's here.[/i]
Ngarrajin said in a direct tone, briefly taking out and showing her the fragment before putting it back in his clothes.
[i]Ah...but, how...[/i]
[i]Copy, neither is real.[/i]
Ngarrajin took the other part of the fragment from his outfit. [i]Ah, but, ugh, whatever...[/i]
Kambilla felt confused about how he had been so easily fooled by the merchant, but at the same time, he felt grateful, since if the attacker had stolen the pieces of her, they would have been just ordinary wooden carvings...
They arrived quickly at Towurunga, probably due to luck and a mix of other factors. After leaving the camels in a pen, they went straight to the healing gunya. Balunji carried Gillut, who was still unconscious. Kambilla did not want to go to the ngankaris. He chose to simply rest in his home next to his grandson. Dulbara and Gillut were placed on a hammock. Tjilpi, "the crow", although a bit eccentric, came to Gillut and examined his injuries. It was a cut on his chest. After examining and running his hand around the area, he announced it to the group. [i]The wound is not fatal, your friend is lucky, but this dark mark will be left on him, I must say, it is something I have never seen, but I have heard, this type of wound is an attack on the spirit, "dark energy", is the name, and there should no longer be living clans with such ability, it corrupts spirit and soul, and physically, destroys the body like a parasite if left untreated.[/i]
The group (Tjarrampa, Ngarrajin and Balunji) looked, paying attention to every word Tjilpi said, he soon said, turning to the patient:
[i]Bring me the acacia leaf extract.[/i]
Tjilpi gave an order to the other healers, one of them reached him, his assistants applied the extract to the wounds, Tjilpi cleaned it, Gillut gave slight moans due to the cold and somewhat painful sensation. [i]...Wadang....listen to me.[/i]
Tjilpi began to speak, as he extended his hand under the cut, he said.
[i]Warawang[/i].
From his arm, a crow figure emerged and went to enter Gillut's wound, it was ripping out the dark energy, and rotten flesh from the wound.
[i]Hey Balunji, it's not just Wonambi who interacts in our physical world apparently.[/i]
Tjarrampa laughed lightly, giving Balunji a light tap on the elbow, he just rolled his eyes and Ngarrajin gave a low, almost imperceptible laugh.
On the other side, Dulbara was receiving an herbal tea from a ngankaris, whose name was Yumdahri, a woman with smooth black skin and crow necklaces, who was assigned to him, the wound was not deep or anything like that.
[i]Why give me this? I AM A DESCENDANT OF WARRIGAL, I don't need it...[/i]
[i]]Even Warrigal needed rest after the battle of the 20 clans.[/i]
Yumdahri responded quickly, she took some Yidi leaves (a leaf known for its analgesic properties) to use as compresses on his chest, which was hit hard by Balunji's blow.
[i]Hmph, at least I can sleep a little.[/i]
Yumdahri sighed in relief when she saw that he had rested his eyes. Finally, Tjipi finished her technique, Gillut was free of the dark energy, the "crow" became a little pale, and left the gunya, giving the excuse: [i]I have... to breathe fresh air.[/i]
Ngarrajin decided to approach Gillut's side, he created a needle from thorns, and then took a nearby sewing thread, Yumdahri decided to intervene, but was stopped by Tjarrampa, who told her:
[i]Rajin knows about medicine...well, at least in animals, so he can be a bit rough.[/i]
[b]AAAAAGH[/b].
Gillut let out a scream when she felt the needle sticks stitching his wounds, Ngarrajin just sighed and murmured:
[i]Animals are easier....[/i]
Yumdahri decided to help, she took leaves of medicinal herbs and placed them on Gillut's chest, this calmed him down, and made him go into "anesthesia". As he finished sewing the wound, Rajin turned the tip of his index finger into flames, weak, cauterizing flames, when he finished, he said:
[i]It's ready.[/i]
And he left without saying anything else, Tjarrampa just laughed lightly and said. [i]Always dramatic Rajin...[/i]
[i]He was powerful, he used dark energy, shouldn't that have been extinct for a long time?[/i]
That's what Balunji asked, he was in front of Mardu and Nghayl, the first had his black feather fan partially covering his face, and the latter remained calm and relaxed, Ngayhl began speaking:
[i]Warrigal charred the totem and their lineage, but they did not destroy them, their totem was blackened and a part, the handle, destroyed.[/i]
Mardu continued speaking:
[i]And this man who attacked you, we do not know who he was, he is from the Purinina, his descendants still live, but few are those who remember their ancestry, Warrigal did not seek to destroy the enemy, but to eliminate their hope and dreams, he broke them when he charred their totems with their own flames.[/i]
Nghayhl concluded:
[i]Perhaps this figure who attacked you found the other fragments of the Murkitilpa clan, and joined them to his to revive his clan, this explains the reason for the sandstorm before the attack.[/i]
[i]I understand...[/i]
Balunji understood, but was still dissatisfied, it was nothing he didn't know, when leaving the guardians' gunya, he came across Kambilla, who asked him about what they said, Balunji was reluctant but said:
[i]Nothing we don't know, he is using his totem to rekindle the energy of the clan itself, and that he descends from a supposedly extinct clan...[/i]
[i]Hmph[/i]...
Kambilla snorted, equally unhappy with the other two guardians' response.
[/spOiler][/quote]
[SpoILeR=Legacy and plannings, Arc of Lost Totem Chap. 7]
[b][i]WARARARARARARARAH[/i][/b]
Sua gargalhada era assustadora ao mesmo tempo que também ecoava pelos ouvidos de Dulbara, aquele era o espírito de Warrigal em seu sonho, sua figura era intangível, feita de puro fogo alaranjado, ele circulou com suas chamas Dulbara e passou a mão em sua cabeça, de com um sorriso mesmo e som crepitante ele começou a dizer.
[i]aaaaaaaaaaaaah vamos lá, olhe para você, seu espírito queima, mas não é por orgulho.....Eu vejo.[/i]
Warrigal se dissipou por um momento breve e ressurgiu flutuante no ar com a mão no queixo, pensante ele começou:
[i]....É algo mais profundo que um mero orgulho clânico, seu espírito arde, por algo que vai além de um mero "orgulho", mas oque é isso?[/i]
O "imperador" aproxima o próprio rosto, e deixa o resto do corpo para trás, deixando apenas sua cabeça de labaredas a frente de Warrigal.
[i]MAS, eu não posso contar, iria arruinar a surpresa.[/i]
Ele reúne a cabeça com o restante do corpo e toca com o dedo indicador na testa de Dulbara.
[i]Você saberá quando a hora chegar, será mais cedo ou mais tarde, depende unicamente de você, seu destino não é viver a minha sombra, Dulbara, seu destino é grandioso![/i]
Warrigal se afasta,  seu corpo se torna mais...físico, ou próximo disso, seu rosto tinha traços típicos, mas, marcantes, seu olho brilhava em cor de fogo, mas, aquele sorriso, era o mais marcante, parecia desafiador, mas também largo e acolhedor, seu corpo tinha cicatrizes e tatuagens clânicas, e seus braços tinham labaredas de fogo brilhantes.
[i]Mas, como....como eu iria me comparar a sua...grandiosidade...?[/i]
Dulbara gaguejou, em resposta, Warrigal se manteve sorridente, e falou com uma voz, meio crepitante:
[i]Warhahah, eu nunca precisei me basear em alguém mesmo nosso clã tendo mais de mil anos de história quando eu nasci, eu criei meu próprio legado por conta, oque impede você, 300 anos após minha morte de fazer o mesmo?[/i]
[i]Eu....não sei.[/i]
Warrigal se aproximou, em passos lentos, mas ritmados, ele pôs a mão direita sob a cabeça de Dulbara.
[i]Nós só morremos quando esquecidos, faça feitos lendários, e você não morrerá, e com isso, a vida eterna alcançará, treine mais duro, a vida eventualmente lhe ensinará.[/i]
Warrigal piscou de leve para Dulbara, o qual respondeu, com certa emoção:
[i]Eu...entendo, mas...como[/i].
[i]Não tenha medo de pedir a outros para lhe treinarem, isso não lhe torna fraco pedir ajuda, oque lhe faz fraco é se achar forte, e assim achar que não precisa da ajuda dos outros.[/i]
[i]Eu...entendo, Imperador[/i].
Warrigal não respondeu, apenas fechou os olhos e sorriu. 
Dulbara acordou.
Era noite já, a luz lunar banhava Towurunga, Yumdahri estava sentada ao lado da rede de Dulbara, ela tomava uma bebida de sementes de Ngarrana(uma fruta cujas sementes podem ser trituradas e colocadas na água para gerar uma espécie de "café", aumenta energia), ao fundo Ngarrajin estava reclinado na porta do Gunya com a perna apoiada na estrutura do abrigo e a outra no solo.
[i]Finalmente acordou, você dormiu o dia todo![/i]
Yumdahri começou anunciando, Dulbara se levantou, estava nu da cintura pra cima, Yumdahri o empurrou de volta para se deitar.
[i]CALME, ainda tenho que tirar as comprensas de você.[/i]
Ela disse removendo as folhas de Yidi do peito de Dulbara, e entregou a ele um manto para se cobrir, ele se levantou meio tonto ainda, então agradeceu:
[i]Muito obrigado.[/i]
[i]Não tem de que.[/i]
Yumdahri respondeu,  já tomando outro gole de seu "café" ela se levantou também e saiu. Colocando o manto, mas indo até os ombros, não conseguia deixar de mostrar sua tatuagem de dingo, foi até Ngarrajin e o perguntou:
[i]Ei...mercador, onde tá o resto do pessoal?[/i]
Rajin apontou para o centro de Towurunga, ao redor da fogueira o conselho se reunia.
[i]Obrigado...[/i]
Dulbara respondeu, e então foi andando até lá, ainda meio desnorteado por ter acordado ainda a pouco tempo, Ngarrajin olhou para Dulbara saindo e falou em voz baixa:
[i]De nada...[/i]
[i]Tava bom o sono, dingu?[/i]
Tjarrampa brincou, Dulbara respondeu dando uma risada leve:
[i][b]Kyakyakya[/b], ah, sim Rampa(Apelido de Tjarrampa)[/i].
Rampa sorriu, e então o Dingu se sentou ao redor da fogueira.
Balunji que estava falando antes, continuou.
[i]Como ia dizendo, nós temos 2 fragmentos, traseira e corcova, e os dois estão com Ngarrajin, e o inimigo aparenta ter os outros dois restantes, cabeça e dianteira.[/i]
Kambilla levantou a mão em pergunta, ele parecia ansioso.
[i]E como podemos derrotar ele?[/i]
Antes de poder responder, Rajin surgiu por trás, Tjar murmurou.
[i]Você e suas entradas dramáticas.[/i]
Ngarrajin então corrigiu Balunji e Kambilla.
[i]Não é "ele", são "eles".[/i]
O mercador deu um chute leve para chamar atenção de Tjarrampa, que em resposta disse:
[i]Pouco antes da nuvem de areia dele se dissipar, vimos outras figuras nos observando nas areias, eles estavam cobertos totalmente por mantos, se escondendo propositalmente, há mais de uma pessoa envolvida, isso é certo.[/i]
Balunji pôs a mão no queixo, e pensou, [i]hmm, isso é, uma opção viável, ao mesmo tempo, interessante.[/i]
Kialja foi a primeira a fala no entanto.
[i]Então estamos lidando com uma ameaça maior que pensávamos.[/i]
[i]EU TENHO UMA PROPOSTA![/i]
Amarunga, até então quieto começou falando, e então continuou:
[i]Eu posso usar meu Warlutja para me camuflar e espionar o inimigo[/i].
Ele sugeriu, aparentemente o conselho aprovou a idéia.
[i]E como saberiam onde eles estão?[/i]
Ngarrajin os surpreendeu com a pergunta, realmente, eles não sabiam onde estava o clã Purinina e seus descendentes abrigados, Wurtalpa do clã Kipara então decidiu dar sua própria proposta.
[i]Se eles realizaram o ritual de fusão totêmica em Nariburu, é seguro dizer que eles estão lá.[/i]
[i]Realmente...[/i]
Balunji concordou, com a idéia, e apontou para Amarunga.
[i]Lagarto(Amarunga, você irá de manhã se infiltrar em Nariburu, e de lá trará as informações necessárias que conseguir, é essencial sua missão.[/i]
[i]Vamos também preparar para nós mesmos irmos depois, afinal, assim que Amarunga chegar já estaremos prontos para ir![/i]
Kialja respondeu.
[i]Ah, sim, claro...[/i]
[i]Bem, está ficando tarde já, e meus olhos já estão ficando pesados...vamos dormir e definir tudo amanhã.[/i]
Balunji finalizou, ao terminar lançou um bocejo, todos concordaram, menos Dulbara, não por ter alguma questão ou proposta, apenas por ter dormido o dia inteiro. 
[i]Eu deveria lhe agradecer por manter o totem seguro...muito obrigado por isso, não sei como agradecer.[/i]
Kambilla disse à Ngarrajin, lhe dando um sorriso amigável, Rajin respondeu com outro sorriso, e um baixo, mas audível:
[i]Não precisa.[/i]

TRANSLATION:
 [b][i]WARARARARARARARAH[/i][/b]
His laughter was frightening at the same time that it also echoed in Dulbara's ears, that was the spirit of Warrigal in his dream, his figure was intangible, made of pure orange fire, he circled Dulbara with his flames and passed his hand over his head, with a smile and a crackling sound he began to say. [i]aaaaaaaaaaaaah come on, look at you, your spirit burns, but it's not out of pride.....I see.[/i]
Warrigal dissipated for a brief moment and resurfaced floating in the air with his hand on his chin, thoughtfully he began:
[i]....It's something deeper than mere clan pride, your spirit burns, for something that goes beyond mere "pride", but what is that?[/i]
The "emperor" brings his own face closer, and leaves the rest of his body behind, leaving only his head of flames in front of Warrigal.
[i]BUT, I can't tell, it would ruin the surprise.[/i]
He brings his head together with the rest of his body and touches Dulbara's forehead with his index finger. [i]You will know when the time comes, it will be sooner or later, it depends solely on you, your destiny is not to live in my shadow, Dulbara, your destiny is great![/i]
Warrigal moves away, his body becomes more... physical, or close to it, his face had typical but striking features, his eyes shone the color of fire, but that smile was the most striking, it seemed defiant, but also wide and welcoming, his body had scars and clan tattoos, and his arms had bright flames of fire. [i]But, how....how could I compare myself to your...greatness...?[/i]
Dulbara stuttered, in response, Warrigal kept smiling, and spoke with a crackling voice:
[i]Warhahah, I never needed to base myself on anyone even though our clan had more than a thousand years of history when I was born, I created my own legacy on my own, what stops you, 300 years after my death, from doing the same?[/i]
[i]I....don't know.[/i]
Warrigal approached, with slow but rhythmic steps, he placed his right hand under Dulbara's head. [i]We only die when forgotten, do legendary deeds, and you will not die, and with that, eternal life will reach, train harder, life will eventually teach you.[/i]
Warrigal winked slightly at Dulbara, who replied, with some emotion:
[i]I...understand, but...how[/i].
[i]Don't be afraid to ask others to train you, that doesn't make you weak to ask for help, what makes you weak is thinking you are strong, and thus thinking you don't need the help of others.[/i]
[i]I...understand, Emperor[/i].
Warrigal didn't answer, he just closed his eyes and smiled.
Dulbara woke up.
It was already night, the moonlight bathed Towurunga, Yumdahri was sitting next to Dulbara's hammock, she was drinking a drink made from Ngarrana seeds (a fruit whose seeds can be crushed and placed in water to create a kind of "coffee", which increases energy), in the background Ngarrajin was reclining at the door of the Gunya with his leg resting on the structure of the shelter and the other on the ground.
[i]Finally you're awake, you've been sleeping all day![/i]
Yumdahri began announcing, Dulbara stood up, he was naked from the waist up, Yumdahri pushed him back to lie down. [i]CALM DOWN, I still have to take the compresses off you.[/i]
She said, removing the Yidi leaves from Dulbara's chest, and handed him a cloak to cover himself. He stood up, still a little dizzy, and thanked him:
[i]Thank you very much.[/i]
[i]You're welcome.[/i]
Yumdahri replied, already taking another sip of her "coffee", she also stood up and left. Putting on the cloak, but going down to her shoulders, she couldn't help but show her dingo tattoo, she went to Ngarrajin and asked him:
[i]Hey...merchant, where are the rest of the people?[/i]
Rajin pointed to the center of Towurunga, around the fire the council was meeting. [i]Thank you...[/i]
Dulbara replied, and then walked over there, still a little disoriented from having woken up just a short time ago. Ngarrajin looked at Dulbara leaving and spoke in a low voice:
[i]You're welcome...[/i]
[i]Was your sleep good, dingu?[/i]
Tjarrampa joked, Dulbara replied with a light laugh:
[i][b]Kyakyakya[/b], oh, yes Rampa (Tjarrampa's nickname)[/i].
Rampa smiled, and then Dingu sat down around the fire.
Balunji, who was speaking before, continued.
[i]As I was saying, we have 2 fragments, rear and hump, and both are with Ngarrajin, and the enemy seems to have the other two remaining, head and front.[/i]
Kambilla raised his hand in question, he seemed anxious. [i]And how can we defeat him?[/i]
Before he could answer, Rajin appeared from behind, Tjar muttered.
[i]You and your dramatic entrances.[/i]
Ngarrajin then corrected Balunji and Kambilla.
[i]It's not "him", it's "them".[/i]
The merchant gave a light kick to get Tjarrampa's attention, who in response said:
[i]Just before his sand cloud dissipated, we saw other figures watching us in the sands, they were completely covered by cloaks, purposefully hiding, there is more than one person involved, that's for sure.[/i]
Balunji put his hand on his chin, and thought, [i]hmm, that's a viable option, at the same time, interesting.[/i]
Kialja was the first to speak however.
[i]So we are dealing with a greater threat than we thought.[/i]
[i]I HAVE A PROPOSAL![/i]
Amarunga, until then quiet, began to speak, and then continued:
[i]I can use my Warlutja to camouflage myself and spy on the enemy[/i].
He suggested, apparently the council approved the idea.
[i]And how would they know where they are?[/i]
Ngarrajin surprised them with the question, really, they did not know where the Purinina clan and their sheltered descendants were, Wurtalpa of the Kipara clan then decided to give his own proposal.
[i]If they performed the totemic fusion ritual in Nariburu, it is safe to say that they are there.[/i]
[i]Indeed...[/i]
Balunji agreed, with the idea, and pointed to Amarunga. [i]Lizard (Amarunga, you will infiltrate Nariburu in the morning, and from there you will bring back the necessary information you can, your mission is essential.[/i]
[i]Let's also prepare ourselves to go later, after all, as soon as Amarunga arrives we will be ready to go![/i]
Kialja replied.
[i]Oh, yes, of course...[/i]
[i]Well, it's getting late already, and my eyes are already getting heavy...let's sleep and define everything tomorrow.[/i]
Balunji finished, when he finished he yawned, everyone agreed, except Dulbara, not because he had any question or proposal, just because he had slept the whole day.
[i]I should thank you for keeping the totem safe...thank you very much for that, I don't know how to thank you.[/i]
Kambilla said to Ngarrajin, giving him a friendly smile, Rajin replied with another smile, and a low but audible:
[i]No need.[/i]
